find_coins.description: Search the 1,800+ crypto assets FraudCoins covers by part of their name or ticker. Exact matches come first, then the largest coins. Each match carries the coin ID every other FraudCoins step accepts.
find_coins.name: find_coins

parameters.description: Part of a coin's name or ticker, such as 'shiba' or 'PEPE'.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: The most coins to return (up to 100).
parameters.name: limit

coins.description: The matching coins, best match first.

coin_id.description: FraudCoins' ID for the coin (for example shiba-inu). Every Coin field accepts it, so one step can hand a coin to the next.

symbol.description: The coin's ticker, such as SHIB.

total_matching.description: How many items matched before the limit was applied.

get_concentration_history.description: Get the dated series of a token's top-10 holder share, up to 180 measurements, with the change from the first to the latest. A point is only recorded when the share changed.
get_concentration_history.display_str_template: Get the holder concentration history of {0}.
get_concentration_history.name: get_concentration_history

parameters.description: The token to look up. The list holds the tokens FraudCoins has scanned on-chain; you can also type a ticker (SHIB), a name, a FraudCoins coin ID (shiba-inu) or the token's contract address. A ticker several coins share means the largest of them.
parameters.name: coin

parameters.description: Only include measurements from this day on. Leave empty for the full history.
parameters.name: since

change_in_points.description: Latest share minus first share, in percentage points. Negative means the supply has spread out.

coin_id.description: FraudCoins' ID for the coin (for example shiba-inu). Every Coin field accepts it, so one step can hand a coin to the next.

first_date.description: The day of the first measurement.

latest_date.description: The day of the latest measurement.

top10_holders_percent.description: Share of the supply (0 to 100) held by the ten largest private wallets, after leaving out burn addresses and labelled exchange, staking, bridge, treasury and liquidity-pool wallets. Empty when never measured.

symbol.description: The coin's ticker, such as SHIB.

get_contract_permissions.description: Check what a token contract's owner can do: mint new tokens, change balances, pause transfers, blacklist wallets, take back ownership, hide the owner or self-destruct, plus whether the contract is upgradeable and its source code published. Each is true, false or empty when the analysis could not tell; empty means unknown, not safe.
get_contract_permissions.name: get_contract_permissions

parameters.description: The token to look up. The list holds the tokens FraudCoins has scanned on-chain; you can also type a ticker (SHIB), a name, a FraudCoins coin ID (shiba-inu) or the token's contract address. A ticker several coins share means the largest of them.
parameters.name: coin

can_mint_new_tokens.description: The owner can create new tokens. Empty when unknown.

can_self_destruct.description: The contract can destroy itself. Empty when unknown.

can_take_back_ownership.description: Ownership can be reclaimed after being given up. Empty when unknown.

coin_id.description: FraudCoins' ID for the coin (for example shiba-inu). Every Coin field accepts it, so one step can hand a coin to the next.

explorer_url.description: The contract on the network's block explorer.

has_blacklist.description: The owner can block wallets from trading. Empty when unknown.

has_hidden_owner.description: The contract has an owner that is not shown publicly. Empty when unknown.

is_upgradeable_proxy.description: The contract's code can be replaced. Common among established projects, so not a warning by itself.

network.description: The network the contract is on.

network_id.description: FraudCoins' short ID for that network.

owner_can_change_balances.description: The owner can change holders' balances. Empty when unknown.

owner_privileges_found.description: The owner privileges the contract has.

owner_privileges_unknown.description: The owner privileges the analysis could not determine.

source_code_published.description: The contract's source code is published and verified.

symbol.description: The coin's ticker, such as SHIB.

transfers_can_be_paused.description: The owner can pause all transfers. Empty when unknown.

get_excluded_holders.description: See which of a token's largest wallets FraudCoins left out of its top-10 figure, and why: exchange, market maker, treasury or vesting, liquidity pool, staking, bridge or burn address. Each comes with its share of the supply and the label it was matched on, so the correction can be checked.
get_excluded_holders.display_str_template: Get the wallets excluded from {0}'s top-10 figure.
get_excluded_holders.name: get_excluded_holders

parameters.description: The token to look up. The list holds the tokens FraudCoins has scanned on-chain; you can also type a ticker (SHIB), a name, a FraudCoins coin ID (shiba-inu) or the token's contract address. A ticker several coins share means the largest of them.
parameters.name: coin

coin_id.description: FraudCoins' ID for the coin (for example shiba-inu). Every Coin field accepts it, so one step can hand a coin to the next.

category.description: Why it was left out: exchange, market-maker, treasury, liquidity, staking, bridge or burn.

category_label.description: The same reason in words, such as Exchange wallet.

entity.description: Who the wallet belongs to, such as Binance.

explorer_url.description: The wallet on the network's block explorer.

label.description: The public address label the decision was based on.

percent_of_supply.description: The wallet's share of the supply (0 to 100).

symbol.description: The coin's ticker, such as SHIB.

total_excluded_percent.description: The excluded wallets' combined share of the supply.

get_holder_concentration.description: Get how much of a token's supply its ten largest wallets hold, measured on-chain, with exchange, staking, bridge and burn wallets left out. Says whether that crosses FraudCoins' flag threshold and when it was measured; tokens are re-measured every few days.
get_holder_concentration.display_str_template: Get the top-10 holder share of {0}.
get_holder_concentration.name: get_holder_concentration

parameters.description: The token to look up. The list holds the tokens FraudCoins has scanned on-chain; you can also type a ticker (SHIB), a name, a FraudCoins coin ID (shiba-inu) or the token's contract address. A ticker several coins share means the largest of them.
parameters.name: coin

coin_id.description: FraudCoins' ID for the coin (for example shiba-inu). Every Coin field accepts it, so one step can hand a coin to the next.

contracts_in_top10.description: How many of the counted top-10 wallets are smart contracts (team and vesting wallets often are).

data_source.description: Which on-chain data provider listed the holders: blockscout or moralis. Figures from the two are not directly comparable.

explorer_url.description: The token on the network's block explorer.

flag_threshold_percent.description: The share at which this token is flagged: 50 for tokens over $50M market cap, 70 for $10M to $50M.

flagged.description: Whether the share has reached this token's flag threshold.

holders_sampled.description: Holder records left after custodial wallets were taken out. Below 50, the reading cannot raise a flag.

measured_at.description: When the holders were measured (UTC timestamp).

network.description: The network the token was scanned on, such as Ethereum.

network_id.description: FraudCoins' short ID for that network: eth, bsc, base, arbitrum, polygon, optimism or avax.

never_flagged.description: True when FraudCoins has reviewed the token by hand and excluded it from flagging.

partial_supply.description: True when this contract holds only part of the coin's supply, for example a bridged copy. Such tokens are never flagged.

raw_top10_holders_percent.description: The same share before exchange and other custodial wallets were left out. Always at least the corrected figure.

size_tier.description: The market-cap tier the token was measured in, which sets how often it is re-measured.

supply_coverage.description: This contract's supply divided by the coin's whole supply. Empty when not reported.

symbol.description: The coin's ticker, such as SHIB.

top10_holders_percent.description: Share of the supply (0 to 100) held by the ten largest private wallets, after leaving out burn addresses and labelled exchange, staking, bridge, treasury and liquidity-pool wallets. Empty when never measured.

top10_wallets_excluded.description: How many of the ten largest wallets were left out as exchange, staking, bridge, treasury, liquidity-pool or burn addresses.

get_risk_rating.description: Get a coin's automated FraudCoins risk score (0 to 100), its risk level, and whether it is flagged because a few wallets hold most of its supply. Works for every coin FraudCoins covers. Ratings are opinion-based risk signals, not proof of wrongdoing.
get_risk_rating.display_str_template: Get the FraudCoins risk rating for {0}.
get_risk_rating.name: get_risk_rating

parameters.description: The coin to look up. Pick it from the list, or type its ticker (SHIB), its name (Shiba Inu), its FraudCoins coin ID (shiba-inu) or its token contract address. A ticker several coins share means the largest of them.
parameters.name: coin

coin_id.description: FraudCoins' ID for the coin (for example shiba-inu). Every Coin field accepts it, so one step can hand a coin to the next.

flagged.description: Whether FraudCoins currently flags the coin for holder concentration.

rated_on.description: The day the rating was worked out (YYYY-MM-DD).

risk_level.description: The score's band: extreme, high, medium or low.

risk_score.description: Automated risk score from 0 (lowest) to 100, combining price drawdown, trading volume, market size, free float, volatility, holder concentration and transparency gaps.

status.description: Where the coin stands: Currently flagged, Recovered (was flagged, no longer is), Monitored, Not recently measured, Dormant or Delisted.

symbol.description: The coin's ticker, such as SHIB.

top10_holders_percent.description: Share of the supply (0 to 100) held by the ten largest private wallets, after leaving out burn addresses and labelled exchange, staking, bridge, treasury and liquidity-pool wallets. Empty when never measured.

list_holder_concentration.description: List the tokens FraudCoins has scanned on-chain, most concentrated first or most recently measured first. Filter by network, by a minimum top-10 holder share, or to flagged tokens only.
list_holder_concentration.display_str_template: List the most concentrated tokens on FraudCoins.

description: Check crypto tokens for the warning signs FraudCoins measures: how much of a token's supply its ten largest wallets hold, what the contract's owner is able to do (mint, pause, blacklist), and an automated risk score for 1,800+ coins. Look up one coin, rank the riskiest, follow a token's concentration over time, or get told when a coin is newly flagged.
